philosophy: The rendered raster is the only honest judge. An SVG is a program; the input image is its observed output corrupted by a known channel (anti-aliasing filter + quantization + maybe JPEG). Vectorization is therefore program induction: find the SIMPLEST, MOST REGULAR program whose anti-aliased render is perceptually indistinguishable from the input. Every heuristic in the current pipeline — corner thresholds, collapse windows, IoU gates, 0.8px symmetry residuals — is a proxy for a question the renderer can answer directly and exactly. So we stop trusting proxies: geometry and ML PROPOSE, the renderer DECIDES, and one universal law (idealization may spend raster error in proportion to the description-length it saves) replaces the entire zoo of hand-tuned accept thresholds. Anti-aliasing is not noise to be smoothed away — it is a free sub-pixel measurement channel: coverage IS signed distance, and every boundary pixel carries roughly one extra decimal digit of edge position. Artifacts are not penalized; they are made structurally impossible (painter's-stack layering kills seams, a spline-fit last rung kills staircases, a curvature-fairness null-space term kills wobble). Determinism is preserved: nothing enters the output that did not win a reproducible, measurable comparison against the source raster.
method_name: RasterCourt — a propose–render–verify vectorizer with coverage-as-evidence, MDL-priced idealization, painter's-stack composition, and differentiable polish
core_idea: Treat the anti-aliased input as a physical measurement of sub-pixel edge positions: per boundary pixel between flat regions A,B, unmix coverage alpha = <c−B, A−B>/||A−B||^2 in linear RGB, invert the calibrated edge-spread function to get signed distance d = ESF^-1(alpha), producing an evidence field of sub-pixel probes (point, normal, offset, confidence) that both replaces MiniNet SR and becomes the scoring ground truth. All existing pipeline stages (corners, DP fitting, templates, regularizers, occlusion completion) are demoted to PROPOSAL generators emitting candidate program edits; each edit is accepted iff its perceptual raster cost does not exceed lambda_mdl times the description-length it saves (one global law instead of dozens of thresholds), scored first by a cheap analytic probe-to-path distance and escalated to an actual tile re-render (Lab-Huber + probe residual + MS-SSIM-lite at 1x and 2x) when within the ambiguity band. The document is a painter's stack, not a partition — every interface is owned by exactly one shape and the shape below extends underneath — so seams cannot exist. After the discrete structure freezes, a diffvg-based continuous polish optimizes control points and colors ON the constraint manifold (rectangle = center/angle/w/h; mirror pair = one shape + reflection; carrier = one line for all members) with a tiny curvature-fairness term that delivers G2-quality smoothness wherever the raster cannot see the difference.
pipeline:
STAGE 0 — DECODE & CHANNEL CALIBRATION. Convert sRGB to linear RGB (all color math and unmixing happens in linear space; this is non-negotiable — coverage is linear in light, and unmixing in gamma space biases edges by up to 0.15px). Alpha: un-premultiply if present; vectorize color and alpha jointly; never assume white backdrop (fixes gap 8). Estimate the edge-spread function: find long straight high-contrast boundary runs (Hough on the strongest Sobel ridges), sample intensity profiles along their normals, fit erf((d−d0)/(sqrt(2)w)); PNG/lossless typically yields w≈0.4–0.5px (near box filter), JPEG yields larger w plus a ringing amplitude estimate. Output: linear image, ESF(w), per-pixel noise sigma_n (from flat-region residuals + JPEG block-boundary map).

STAGE 1 — SEGMENTATION (reused, native resolution always). compact_palette + Lab nearest-anchor + ICM Potts + sliver merge + enclosed-counter rescue, unchanged, but run on the NATIVE raster in all cases. MiniNet 4x SR is retired from the main path (the alpha-unmixing in Stage 2 recovers the sub-pixel information SR was hallucinating, deterministically); it remains an optional preprocessor for heavily degraded input where unmixing confidence collapses. Palette anchors become color INITIALIZATION only, not final colors (fixes gap 9).

STAGE 2 — EVIDENCE FIELD. Trace crack loops with the existing mask_loops / region_graph tracer (guaranteed closed, kissing-safe). For each crack sample on an interface between regions A and B: take the boundary pixel(s) it crosses, compute alpha_i by projecting the pixel's linear color onto the A–B segment; sub-pixel offset d_i = ESF^-1(alpha_i) along the local crack normal n_i; probe position p_i = crack midpoint + d_i·n_i. Confidence: sigma_i from (a) unmixing residual orthogonal to the A–B color segment (3-color junction pixels fail this — attempt 3-way barycentric unmix against the three adjacent region colors; if residual still high, set sigma=inf), (b) local half-plane model check: predict the 3x3 neighborhood's coverages from a single line hypothesis (least squares over 9 alphas); high residual means corner/junction/curved-below-pixel — inflate sigma (corners get their final position from analytic support intersection anyway), (c) JPEG ringing map. Typical clean-render accuracy: 0.03–0.08px; typical JPEG: 0.2–0.4px. The evidence field E = {(p_i, n_i, d_i, sigma_i)} per interface is the ground truth for everything downstream. The DP fitter's directional interval constraint changes from ±0.5px around integer midpoints to ±max(0.5, 2sigma_i) around p_i — on clean input the corridor SHRINKS to ~±0.15px, which by itself removes freeform-fit wobble because the fit is over-constrained.

STAGE 3 — DOCUMENT LAYOUT (painter's stack). Build the region adjacency graph; infer a partial depth order: containment implies below; existing occlusion-completion evidence implies below; T-junction tangent continuation across an interface implies the continuing shape is below; ties broken by (larger area, touches image border, background-colored) => below. Topological sort => z-order. Bottom layer: full-canvas rect in the true background color (or transparent if source alpha says so). Each shape that LOSES an interface (is below) has its outline inflated +0.75px along that interface only (offset along evidence normals; never a global dilate); the winner keeps the true evidence-fit boundary. Verify the order by one full render vs source; interface color error localizes wrong orderings; repair by local pairwise swaps (greedy, at most a few — flat art has shallow stacks). Occlusion completion (existing) upgrades naturally: completed rect/ellipse templates are emitted as full shapes at their inferred depth. Seams, hairline gaps, and white show-through are now geometrically impossible: any residual geometric error moves an interface but never opens a hole, because paint always exists underneath.

STAGE 4 — STRUCTURE PROPOSALS (all existing machinery, demoted to proposers).
(a) Corners: run the existing CNN routing at threshold 0.15 (superset), KEEP probabilities (fixes gap 11). NMS only; no recentering-collapse-removal cascade as a hard filter — those become priced edits.
(b) Template league for small loops (area <= ~120px^2) and glyph-classified regions: candidate parametric programs {rect(cx,cy,w,h,theta), rounded-rect(+r), circle, ellipse, superellipse(+n), diamond, capsule, N-gon, cross, star, font_match glyph (finally integrated — the court verifies, so its conservative gate relaxes to top-3 retrieval)}. Each template is fit DIRECTLY to the coverage field, no polygonization: minimize sum_pixels (alpha_pred(template) − alpha_obs)^2 where alpha_pred is the template's exact pixel coverage (analytic for these primitives), 30 Adam steps over 3–7 parameters. A 6x6 rounded square has ~20 informative boundary alphas constraining 5 parameters — over-determined 4:1, which is WHY tiny shapes come out sub-pixel exact.
(c) Freeform: corner-optional shortest-path DP over the sub-pixel probes with the existing vocabulary line/arc/clothoid/biarc/cubic PLUS an elliptical-arc primitive at r=3 (conic through the interval corridor; fixes gap 6), 12 tangent bins, G1 penalty as today. Each corner hypothesis is a DP node usable in two modes: vertex mode (tangent discontinuity allowed, cost += MDL_corner + mu·(1−p_cnn)) or pass-through mode (cost += mu·p_cnn if p_cnn high). Adjacent letter corners are no longer erased by the 16·spacing window — erasing one must now WIN a tile-render comparison, and on a 10px glyph removing a real corner visibly changes coverage, so it loses. This attacks the F1≈0.73 ceiling from the decision side rather than the detector side.
(d) Gradient-stack merge and stroke detection: reused verbatim as proposal sources (their accepts also go through the court).

STAGE 5 — THE COURT (discrete accept/reject). Maintain a priority queue of candidate edits: per-loop simplifications (drop corner, merge primitives, replace freeform with template), cross-loop regularities (axis snap, parallel/orthogonal clusters, shared carriers, co-circular groups — all existing detectors), symmetry proposals (mirror at ARBITRARY axis: candidate axes from shape PCA directions and perpendicular bisectors of matched-shape centroid pairs, scored by chamfer of shape vs reflection; rotation about circumcenters of matched repeats, not just centroid), repeated-shape unification by raster chamfer after Procrustes (NOT degree-sequence identity — the court doesn't care how a shape was decomposed; unification = adopt the better outline + per-instance transform), glyph baseline/x-height/stem-width carriers, depth swaps. ACCEPTANCE LAW: accept edit e iff DeltaL_perc(e) <= lambda_mdl · DeltaMDL(e) + tau_floor, where DeltaMDL is the description-length saved (primitives removed x ~40 bits, each parameter shared across a group x ~30 bits, corner removed x ~25 bits — coarse integer costs, only ratios matter) and tau_floor ≈ render-noise floor. lambda_mdl is THE single global knob, calibrated once on the 365 annotated logos. SCORING, two channels: (1) cheap analytic — sum over affected probes of Huber(dist(p_i, nearest point on candidate vector path)/sigma_i); closed-form point-to-primitive distance, no render, microseconds; (2) full tile render — only for edits within the ambiguity band of channel 1, or that change color/topology/layering: re-render the affected tiles (analytic coverage rasterizer: scanline exact trapezoid coverage, curves flattened at 1/64px, deterministic; render at 1x and at 2x then downsample through the calibrated ESF so sub-pixel misplacement shows up as AA-value error), score L = w1·HuberMean(DeltaE_ab) + w2·probe term + w3·(1 − MS-SSIM-lite on L channel, 5x5 window). Tile hashing invalidates cached scores; iterate the queue to fixpoint (1–3 sweeps; edits are local). HARD VETO independent of MDL: an edit is rejected if >2% of a shape's high-confidence probes (sigma<0.15px) end up >1.5px from the path — deliberate asymmetry manifests as a coherent block of vetoing probes, which bounds idealization.

STAGE 6 — CONTINUOUS POLISH (differentiable). Freeze discrete structure and constraints; build the reduced parameter vector by hard reparameterization of every accepted regularity: rectangle => (cx,cy,w,h,theta); mirror group => one outline + axis(2 params); N-fold => one wedge + center; carrier line => one (n,c) shared by all member segments; co-circular => one (center,r); repeated glyph => one outline + per-instance similarity transform; region colors and gradient stops are free variables. Optimize with diffvg (torch/CUDA available) at 1x + 2x: loss = the same L_perc + epsilon·FAIR where FAIR = sum over flattened samples of (kappa'(s))^2·ds (discrete second difference of turning angle), epsilon tuned so FAIR only acts in the raster's null space (sub-AA wiggle). This term is how G2 arrives without clothoid bookkeeping (fixes gap 3): curvature steps that the raster can't discriminate get ironed flat; curvature steps the raster CAN see are real and stay. 100–300 Adam steps, lr 0.02px geometry / separate lr for colors, early stop at Delta-loss < tau_floor. Typical icon: <2s on GPU. Colors initialized from interior medians (pixels >=1px from any boundary, linear RGB) and refined here — final colors come from the source, not palette anchors.

STAGE 7 — EMISSION & SELF-AUDIT. Emit painter's stack; exact primitives (rect/circle/ellipse/arc) kept exact, freeform as 0.01px-rounded cubics (VAI-style profile also available: everything-as-cubics). Final audit render at 1x/2x/4x: per-region DeltaE map, probe-residual histogram, wobble metric (curvature variance over near-straight runs), roundness metric (radial residual of arc clusters), seam scan (alpha holes at 4x). These metrics ARE the new benchmark harness and run identically on vectorizer.ai output for A/B (fixes gap 10 by construction).

FALLBACK LADDER (abolishes staircases, fixes gap 2): rung 1 paper fit; rung 2 refit with relaxed vocabulary (alpha halved, more corners); rung 3 corner-optional cubic-only DP on probes; rung 4 direct differentiable fit — closed cubic B-spline with n = perimeter/3 control points initialized on the probes, optimized with L_perc + FAIR (LIVE-style). Rung 4 always converges to something smooth and raster-faithful; the pixel-staircase polyline and the IoU-0.90 gate that shipped 86-line glyphs are deleted. Every rung is scored by the same court; ship the best-scoring rung.
small_images: Small shapes are where analysis-by-synthesis is strongest, because anti-aliasing makes them OVER-determined rather than under-determined: each boundary pixel's coverage value contributes ~1 decimal digit of sub-pixel edge position, so a 6x6px rounded square offers ~20 informative constraints for 5 template parameters. The template league (Stage 4b) fits parametric programs directly to the coverage field — predicted analytic pixel coverage vs observed alpha — with no polygonization step at all, so tiny squares, diamonds, rounded rects, capsules and dots come out as exact idealized primitives with sub-pixel center/size/radius, ending the current ellipse-or-pixel-chain dichotomy (gap 4). Tiny letter counters survive via the existing enclosed-counter rescue plus 3-way junction unmixing. Corner erasure on small shapes stops because removal must win a tile-render comparison, and at small scales every corner controls visibly many coverage values, so true corners always win their case. The 2x-render-then-ESF-downsample scoring channel specifically catches sub-pixel misplacement that a 1x comparison would alias away.
text: Five mutually reinforcing mechanisms. (1) The staircase pathway is deleted: the fallback ladder ends in a smooth differentiable spline fit, so the documented failure (valid 5–8 primitive glyphs replaced by 29–86 staircase lines by the IoU gate) is structurally impossible — the IoU gate itself is replaced by the perceptual loss. (2) Corner-optional DP with retained CNN probabilities keeps serif/terminal/adjacent corners on small text: collapsing two adjacent letter corners must now win a render comparison, which it loses whenever the letterform visibly changes — recall problems become precision problems, which the court solves. (3) Repeated-glyph unification by raster chamfer (not primitive-decomposition identity): every 'o' in a wordmark becomes one outline plus placements, jointly verified, massively raising per-glyph evidence. (4) Baseline / x-height / cap-height / stem-width become shared carriers in the continuous polish, so strokes equalize exactly where the raster permits. (5) font_match.py finally enters the pipeline as a proposal source — top-3 retrieved glyph outlines compete in the template league; the court's render verification is what makes relaxing its conservative gate safe (a wrong font loses on raster evidence; a right font wins with a huge MDL bonus). Scoring at 2x exposes stroke-weight errors as AA differences that 1x would hide.
symmetry_idealization: One law prices ALL idealization: accept iff DeltaL_perc <= lambda_mdl·DeltaMDL + tau_floor. Symmetry, parallelism, co-circularity, axis snap, repetition and template replacement are just edits with large DeltaMDL (they factor parameters out of the program), so they are allowed to spend proportionally more raster error — which is exactly the correct scale-adaptive behavior: a mirror symmetry costing 1.3px of edge motion on a 400px logo passes (huge MDL saving, small relative perceptual cost measured by the actual render), while the same 1.3px on a 24px icon fails because the rendered Lab/SSIM cost explodes at that scale. This replaces the fixed 0.8px mirror residual, the 1–2px budgets, and the snapshot-revert heuristics. Coverage is broadened: mirror axes at arbitrary angles (candidates from shape PCA axes and perpendicular bisectors between matched shapes, screened by reflection chamfer), rotation centers from circumcenters of matched repeats rather than centroid-only, repeats matched by Procrustes + raster chamfer so identical shapes with different primitive decompositions still unify (fixes gap 7). Idealization is BOUNDED three ways: (a) the rendered loss is the real perceptual cost, not a proxy, so over-idealization is self-limiting; (b) hard veto if >2% of a shape's high-confidence probes (sigma<0.15px) move >1.5px — deliberate asymmetry produces a coherent vetoing block; (c) after acceptance, constraints become hard reparameterizations in the continuous polish, so the optimizer cannot silently drift back off the regularity — symmetric stays exactly symmetric, and the remaining freedom is spent where the raster demands it.
artifact_elimination: SEAMS: structurally impossible — painter's-stack document (Stage 3) means every interface is owned by one shape and the loser extends 0.75px underneath; errors move an interface but can never open a gap; the 4x seam scan in the audit is expected to read zero, not merely small. Depth-order mistakes are detected by render disagreement at interfaces and repaired by local swaps. STAIRCASES: the pixel-polyline fallback is deleted; the ladder's terminal rung is a differentiable spline fit with curvature-fairness, so the worst possible output is a smooth, raster-faithful curve; additionally, DP now runs on sub-pixel probes with ~±0.15px corridors on clean input, so staircases collapse to lines even more decisively than with the current midpoint intervals. WOBBLE: three independent killers — shrunken evidence corridors over-constrain the fit; the FAIR term (integral of squared curvature derivative) irons out sub-AA wiggle in the optimizer's null space; and the wobble metric (curvature variance on near-straight runs) is a shipped audit gate. CURVATURE STEPS: the fairness term flows curvature continuity through G1 joints wherever the raster cannot distinguish, giving effective G2 on large smooth silhouettes without clothoid endpoint-drift hacks; steps that remain are ones the raster actually shows. WRONG CORNERS (missed or hallucinated): probabilities kept to the end, every keep/drop decision individually priced by rendered evidence; hallucinated corners cost MDL and buy no loss reduction (rejected), missed corners leave visible coverage error at the vertex tile (their removal edit is rejected). WRONG COLORS: re-estimated from interior pixels and refined differentiably against the source. Every artifact class also has a numeric audit metric that runs on both our output and vectorizer.ai's, so regressions are caught mechanically.

new_components.name: Evidence extractor (coverage unmixing + ESF calibration)
new_components.what: Linear-RGB alpha unmixing per boundary pixel, 2-way and 3-way (junction) barycentric unmix, erf-ESF calibration from straight-edge profiles, JPEG ringing/noise model, per-probe sigma; outputs the sub-pixel evidence field consumed by DP, templates, court, and polish.

new_components.name: Deterministic tile coverage rasterizer + scorer
new_components.what: Scanline exact-trapezoid coverage rasterizer for lines/arcs/cubics (1/64px flattening), 1x and 2x-with-ESF-downsample rendering of dirty tiles only; Lab-Huber + probe-residual + MS-SSIM-lite scoring; tile hash cache. GPU batch via torch where hot, CPU/numba fallback.

new_components.name: MDL edit court
new_components.what: Edit queue with typed edits (drop-corner, merge-prims, template-swap, carrier-join, mirror, rotation, repeat-unify, depth-swap), integer MDL costing, two-channel scoring (analytic probe distance, escalate to tile render), accept law with hard probe-block veto, fixpoint sweeps.

new_components.name: Painter's-stack document builder
new_components.what: Depth-order inference from containment/T-junctions/occlusion evidence, topological sort, per-interface under-inflation of losing shapes, render-verified order repair by local swaps, background/alpha handling.

new_components.name: Template league for small loops and glyphs
new_components.what: Parametric templates (rect, rounded-rect, circle, ellipse, superellipse, diamond, capsule, N-gon, cross, star) fit directly to the coverage field via analytic-coverage Adam (30 steps, 3-7 params); font_match top-3 glyphs as competitors; MDL-priced entry into the court.

new_components.name: Corner-optional DP extension
new_components.what: Corner hypotheses as dual-mode DP nodes (vertex vs pass-through) priced by CNN probability + MDL; probe-based corridors ±2sigma; elliptical-arc primitive (r=3, conic).

new_components.name: Differentiable polish stage
new_components.what: Constraint-manifold reparameterization (symmetry groups, carriers, templates as reduced params), diffvg (or in-house boundary-integral coverage gradients as Windows fallback) at 1x+2x, L_perc + curvature-fairness, colors and gradient stops as free variables, early stop at render-noise floor.

new_components.name: Fallback ladder rung 4 (direct spline fit)
new_components.what: Closed cubic B-spline initialized on probes (n = perimeter/3 control points), optimized with L_perc + FAIR; replaces the pixel-staircase fallback and the IoU-0.90 gate.

new_components.name: Perceptual audit harness + VAI A/B
new_components.what: Per-region DeltaE maps, probe-residual histograms, wobble/roundness/seam metrics at 1x/2x/4x; identical scoring of vectorizer.ai SVGs; lambda_mdl calibration on the 365 annotated logos; blind human-study tooling.

risks: JPEG evidence degradation: ringing and block noise corrupt alpha-unmixing; mitigation is honest sigma inflation (probes degrade gracefully to the current ±0.5px corridors), ESF calibration per image, and Huber robustness — but on very low-quality JPEGs the method's edge falls back to roughly current behavior.

lambda_mdl is still one knob and MDL bit-costs are coarse; miscalibration either over-idealizes (deliberate asymmetry flattened) or under-idealizes; mitigated by calibration against the 365 annotated logos, the probe-block hard veto, and per-category (icon/text/logo) validation — but expect one full tuning cycle.

Court runtime blow-up on large documents if too many edits escalate to tile renders; mitigated by the cheap analytic channel filtering ~90% of edits, tile locality, and GPU batching; budget says seconds per icon, but a pathological 500-region poster could take tens of seconds — needs an edit-budget cap.

Depth-order inference errors on ambiguous flat art cause interface color bleed; the court detects and swap-repairs, but a genuinely cyclic visual order (rare interlocking logos) forces a per-neighborhood fallback to the partition/paper-regions mode — this fallback path must be kept working.

diffvg on Windows is a finicky build (custom CUDA extension); fallback plan (in-house differentiable coverage via boundary-integral gradients for lines/arcs/cubics) is real but adds ~4 days if needed.

Local minima in continuous polish if court output is far from optimum (mostly after fallback rung 4 on messy shapes); mitigated by good initialization from probes and by 2x-scale loss smoothing the landscape.

Painter's-stack under-inflation (+0.75px) slightly changes semantic region areas; irrelevant visually but the existing IoU-floor certification harness must be re-based on rendered output rather than region masks, or floors will falsely regress.
staged_plan: Stage A — Evidence field + probe scorer. Gate: on synthetic anti-aliased renders of known SVGs, recovered edge-position RMSE <= 0.08px (box/erf filters) and <= 0.35px on quality-85 JPEG re-encodes; baseline probe-residual histograms recorded for the current pipeline on the 11 real-logo floors.

Stage B — Painter's-stack builder + under-inflation + audit renderer. Gate: zero seam/show-through pixels in the 4x alpha scan on all certified logos; certified IoU floors (re-based on rendered output) maintained: Mastercard >= 0.9901, Mobil >= 0.9849, NBC >= 0.9855, Lacoste >= 0.9380.

Stage C — Court v1 (per-loop edits only) replacing Hausdorff/IoU backstop + fallback ladder with spline rung. Gate: staircase fallback rate = 0 on the text corpus; average primitives per glyph <= 9; no certified-logo regression; probe residual median improves vs Stage A baseline.

Stage D — Corner-optional DP with retained probabilities + elliptical arc. Gate: corner event-F1 >= 0.80 on the Hoshyari+human GT (from 0.73-0.74); small-text tile DeltaE improves on >= 80% of the wordmark sample.

Stage E — Template league + font_match integration. Gate: on a 200-icon <=32px iconify suite, probe-residual + roundness + wobble metrics beat current pipeline on >= 90% of items; tiny-loop pixel-chain emissions = 0.

Stage F — Cross-loop regularities under the MDL law (arbitrary mirror axes, circumcenter rotations, chamfer repeats). Gate: regularity accept/reject decisions match human annotation on the 365-logo set >= 85%; no probe-block veto violations shipped.

Stage G — Differentiable polish + color re-estimation + alpha path. Gate: IKEA forensics MAE/RMSE beats vectorizer.ai's 4.66/9.95; wobble metric halved vs Stage C; polish runtime <= 2s median per icon on the GPU box.
Stage H — VAI A/B harness + blind human study (100 mixed images: icons, text, logos). Gate: >= 55% overall human preference vs vectorizer.ai and no category below 45%; ship.
why_beats_vai: Every secret the forensics extracted from vectorizer.ai is subsumed here — hidden-layer completion (painter's stack + occlusion templates), global optimization (the court + continuous polish), 0.01px cubic emission, letters redrawn on top — but VAI stops at faithfulness: its output is accurate yet not idealized (near-rectangles stay near-rectangles, near-symmetry stays broken), because it has no economy in which spending raster error to buy regularity is a rational trade. RasterCourt has exactly that economy, with the render as auditor, so it produces the idealized, symmetric, artifact-free output humans actually prefer while PROVING per-image that it never drifted beyond perceptual tolerance — the audit metrics run on VAI's own SVGs, so every win is measured, not asserted. On the current weak spots it is structurally superior: tiny icons (coverage over-determination + template league gives sub-pixel exact parametric shapes where VAI emits generic cubics), small text (no staircase pathway exists, corners defended by rendered evidence, glyph repetition unified), and smooth silhouettes (fairness-polished effective-G2 that VAI's outputs measurably lack — their curvature is only C1 at segment joints). And it keeps the team's core constraint: fully deterministic, debuggable decisions — ML proposes, geometry renders, arithmetic decides — so it can never hallucinate the way end-to-end neural competitors do; every primitive in the output file won a recorded case against the source raster.
